This page records the [AutomatosX/ax-code collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/AutomatosX/ax-code) and exact download revisions. Selected models are in AX Code's reviewed collection; native readiness and tool support are still checked before use. These are observed publisher revisions, not a compatibility guarantee or a change to the revision pinned by an installed runtime. New collection entries remain pending review until explicitly admitted by the runtime.

Public, ungated Hugging Face models can be downloaded without an account. A personal HF login is optional for higher request limits; gated or private repositories require authorization.

R2 availability applies only to the exact revision above. A missing or stale mirror is not a download source. The mirror inventory records reviewed publication receipts; this page does not activate a mirror in the runtime. No R2 model mirrors are currently configured when every row says Not published.

HF remains the active download source. R2 is not assumed faster: multi-GB model shards may exceed Cloudflare CDN cacheable-object limits. Mirror publication requires review of redistribution terms, signed manifests, file sizes and SHA-256 digests, and a verified download receipt. Preserve the selected HF cache location; existing local model directories can also be imported with AX Engine.

If Hugging Face is unavailable and the R2 mirror column links a manifest, download that manifest and every file it lists from https://models.ax-code.app/. Each revision is addressed as `https://models.ax-code.app/<repository>/<revision>/` and is not mixed with release archives. Check each SHA-256, keep the files in one directory, and register them with `ax-code providers ax-engine prepare --model-path <dir>`. AX Code does not switch its own downloader to R2.

See the [publication workflow](model-download-publication.md) for updates. A publisher notification triggers a reviewable documentation proposal through the model-downloads workflow. Scheduled refreshes catch missed notifications. Runtime admission, R2 publication, and merging the proposal remain separate reviewed actions.
